personality: 4 Tactile / Playful structure with 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal earthy palette
personality_one_liner: A grounded, touchable, and deeply human interface that blends 3D tactile elements with a warm, rural Indian color palette to make rural ride-booking feel approachable, reliable, and native.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding for a tactile 3D feel. Interactive elements should feel chunky, touchable, and distinct from the background.

do's: Apply to floating action buttons over the map.
Apply to top floating search bars or landmark chips containers scrolling over the map.
Apply to bottom sheet drag handles and headers.
dont's: Do not blur dense form fields or data-heavy summary cards.
Avoid on low-end Android devices (use solid surfaceSecondary instead).

screens.name: Home / Find Ride
screens.purpose: Primary map interface for passengers to set pickup/drop and request a ride.

states.loading: Map skeleton with pulsing center pin.
states.empty: No rides available - display rural landscape illustration with 'No return rides found nearby' and a 'Notify Me' CTA.
states.error: Location access denied message with a 'Grant Permission' button.

screens.layout: Full-screen OpenStreetMap view. Top safe-area contains a glass-morphic floating search bar with a hamburger menu. Map has a draggable center pin for precise location selection. A bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet) displays quick landmark chips (Bus Stand, Temple, Market) in a horizontally scrolling list, and a chunky, 3D primary CTA to 'Confirm Pickup'.

screens.name: Route Preview & Booking
screens.purpose: Review route line, distance, ETA, and estimated fare before confirming the booking.

states.loading: Skeleton text on the bottom sheet while route is fetched.
states.error: Failed to calculate route - 'Retry Route' CTA.

screens.layout: Map zoomed to fit the route polyline. Bottom sheet expanded to show chunky, tactile chips for Distance, ETA, and Fare in a 2-column grid or horizontal scroll. A large, raised (shadow 2) sticky CTA at the bottom: 'Book Return Ride'.

screens.name: Active Trip / Tracking
screens.purpose: Live tracking of the driver with the prominent 4-digit OTP for starting the ride.
screens.layout: Live map with moving car marker. Bottom sheet pinned, containing Driver profile (photo + name + rating) and a large, high-contrast OTP section (4 big tactile boxes). Underneath, emergency/support actions and a 'Cancel' button.

screens.name: Trip Summary & Fare Breakdown
screens.purpose: Post-ride receipt showing exact fare breakdown and allowing payment and rating.

states.error: Payment failed - retry with Cash/UPI options.

screens.layout: Non-map screen. Earthy surface background. A large, chunky receipt card detailing base fare, return-trip discount, pool discount, and CO2 saved. Prominent total amount. Below the card, 3D payment method chips (Cash, UPI, Wallet) and a 5-star rating widget. Sticky 'Pay & Submit' button at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the earthy, rural Indian color palette rigorously. No blues, indigos, or purples anywhere in the UI. Use Terracotta (#C36F4E) for primary actions and Mustard/Sage for secondary accents.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, chips, OTP boxes) have a tactile, 3D feel using generous padding, radius_tokens (sm/md), and shadow_tier 2.
Implement the Start-Ride OTP as 4 large, separated, chunky digit boxes for high visibility in outdoor rural environments.
For the Map UI, use a full-screen layout with @gorhom/bottom-sheet for interactive controls. Ensure the map center pin is draggable and updates the bottom sheet address.
Landmark chips (Bus Stand, Temple, Market) must be prominently displayed as horizontally scrolling tactile pills in the Location Picker bottom sheet.
Use react-native-reanimated for smooth 3D press transitions (scale down slightly on press) and seamless bottom-sheet snapping.
